aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid comparable evidence but misidentifies the report context and pairs results across mismatched line/date groups.
issues: Review title and purpose use Decap sheet instead of main Test report.
Line L/R are treated as changed conditions instead of subgroup keys.
Normal baselines are mismatched for Line R and 2026-01-02 tests.
Measurement outcome is derived from header-only data and is not valid.
Changed-factor evidence omits key Test purpose/content rows.
correctionPlan: Use Test sheet title, purpose, content, and compare-with-normal rows as primary context.
Set primary factor to adding two 0.14 mm tapes to the F-PCB press jig.
Keep date, line, and VP press jig variant as subgroup or secondary conditions.
Pair row 14 with 16, rows 18 and 20 with 22, and row 24 with 26.
Remove header-only measurement stats; retain function NG rate outcomes only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but final evidence needs corrected Test row grouping and context rows.
